title: Arrian, Anabasis of Alexander 2.11–2.27 (trans. E. J. Chinnock, 1884)

verification_log.method: Read in the downloaded Gutenberg text

After Issus, Parmenio seized the Persian treasure at Damascus; Tyre was captured "in the month Hecatombaion, when Anicetus was archon at Athens" (translator: late July–early August 332); the rest of Palestine Syria yielded except Gaza under Batis, which was stormed, its men killed and women and children enslaved; from Gaza to Pelusium in seven days
